conviction_note: Little here is unpriced. Consensus ($0.95-0.96) sits almost exactly on what the company's own Q3 guide implies (about $0.95 by my arithmetic). SMBK has beaten its last two prints by $0.04-0.13 and rose 6 of 7 times, mostly by 2-3%. Against that, peers' Q3 deposit costs rose (FBK, FHN) and short interest doubled into the print. So: a mild lean up (p_up 55) on a median-sized move (abs 3.5). The findings net to +0.15, close to the scaled +0.35; the gap is just the history's up-bias carried in p_up.
bar: Q3 2026 diluted EPS about $0.95-0.96. Earnings Whispers has $0.96 with revenue $57.63M (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/SMBK). TickFlow's snapshot of 2026-08-03 has four analysts at $0.94-0.96, average $0.95, revenue about $58M (https://www.tickflow.io/stock/SMBK/forecast). Q2 call guidance per Quartr's summary (https://quartr.com/events/smartfinancial-inc-smbk-q2-2026_ofek26C3): NIM about 3.45% (Q2 was 3.52%, 3.48% excluding prepayment fees), noninterest income about $8M, noninterest expense $34.5-35M, tax rate 19.5%. My guide-implied EPS: average earning assets about $5.69B (+3% q/q) x 3.45% x 92/365 = about $49M NII, plus $8M fees, less $34.75M expense and about $2M provision, taxed at 19.5%, over about 17.15M diluted shares = about $0.95. The bar therefore sits ON the guide. Management's public goal is $1.00 EPS in Q4 2026 (the 'four-by-four' target, Q1 call, https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/04/20/smartfinancial-smbk-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/).
positioning_check: No usable option chain: 17 contracts of open interest and no two-sided ATM quote, so there is no skew and no implied move. FINRA short interest via equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/smbk/shortinterest): 328,297 shares on 2026-07-15, 333,431 on 07-31, 366,868 on 08-14, 395,088 on 08-31, 498,474 on 09-15 and 636,039 on 09-30 (3.94 days to cover). That is about 3.7% of the 17,098,473 shares outstanding (10-Q cover). The position nearly doubled since the Q2 print and is building, but it is not crowded. Run-up: 20 days -1.3%, 5 days +1.2%, 4.4% under the 52-week high. Average volume about 109k shares a day.

findings.finding: SMBK beats consensus by habit, and the Q3 bar is only its own guide. Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $0.96 against a $0.90-0.92 consensus, on 15% annualized loan growth and NIM of 3.52%. Q3 2025 was $0.86 against $0.73. The Q3 2026 consensus of $0.95-0.96 equals the guide-implied EPS (about $0.95 on NIM 3.45%, expense $34.5-35M, tax 19.5%). Any NIM at or above the normalized 3.48%, or loan growth near Q2's pace, prints a few cents above the bar. The release slides add a known tailwind: $120M of fixed-rate loans at 5.04% and $15M of adjustable loans at 4.47% mature or reprice in 3Q26, into loan yields of about 5.95%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS beats bought modest gains: Q2 2026 beat of $0.04-0.06 → +1.95%; Q3 2025 beat ($0.86 vs $0.73) → +2.98%. 6 of the last 7 prints rose, with a median absolute move of 2.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus has not moved off the guide since August (TickFlow 2026-08-03: $0.95). If the street expected a repeat beat, estimates would sit at $0.98-1.00, closer to management's public Q4 $1.00 goal. They do not. This is partly priced, since the beat habit is visible to anyone, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The repricing schedule is in the Q2 investor presentation (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001038773/000110465926085102/smbk-20260720xex99d2.htm). The Q2 beat size comes from 247wallst (https://247wallst.com/cards/smartfinancial-q2-2026-earnings-smbk-01ky0nghwm2080y5cypfessec3). Both come from the same company print, so this is one finding.

findings.finding: Peers that reported after SMBK last spoke show deposit costs still rising in Q3 2026. FB Financial, a direct Tennessee peer (10-13), saw total deposit cost go from 2.26% to 2.32% and NIM fall 12bp to 3.83%, with revenue below consensus. First Horizon (10-15) had interest-bearing deposit costs up 12bp to 2.45%. SMBK's own funding mix is moving the same way: noninterest-bearing deposits fell from $1.063B to $922M in H1 2026, time deposits rose from $871M to $987M, and loans (+15% annualized) are outgrowing core deposits (+6%). This puts some risk on SMBK meeting even its 3.45% NIM guide. Home BancShares (core NIM +3bp) is the counter-example.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SMBK has not missed a margin guide in the baseline window. Q2 NIM rose 4bp and the stock went +1.95%. No history of a margin miss on this name to cite.
findings.why_not_priced: SMBK already guided NIM down 7bp, citing deposit pressure, so much of this is inside the guide. What is new is that a same-state peer took a 12bp NIM hit after SMBK spoke. Had the market priced a SMBK margin miss, the stock would have lagged the 52-week high by more than 4% and estimates would have come down. Neither happened.
findings.independence: First Horizon Q3 2026 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000036966/000003696626000178/a3q2026earningsrelease.htm) and SMBK's 10-Q balance sheet (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001038773/000110465926093447/smbk-20260630x10q.htm). It is a peer proxy; SMBK itself has not confirmed it. Counter-evidence: Home BancShares core NIM +3bp (https://finviz.com/news/402737/home-bancshares-reports-record-third-quarter-net-income-bringing-the-company-closer-to-a-half-billion-dollar-year).

findings.finding: The FOMC raised the federal funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16, after the Q2 call. SMBK is mildly asset-sensitive: $1.9B of its $4.7B loans are short-term variable and reset within 1-3 months, and its own model shows +0.8% of 12-month interest income for a static +100bp. That gives a small tailwind to the Q4 NIM outlook the call will give, against continued deposit-cost pressure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior NIM-outlook change on this name to cite. The Q2 guide of a lower NIM coincided with a +1.95% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The hike is public. Its translation to SMBK is a slide most holders will not have modelled. The company's own sensitivity is small (about $0.01 EPS per quarter for 25bp before deposit beta), hence the small size.
findings.independence: SMBK's rate-sensitivity slide 17 in the Q2 presentation (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001038773/000110465926085102/smbk-20260720xex99d2.htm). This is macro-to-company transmission, not confirmed by the company for Q3/Q4.

findings.finding: Management's public goal is $1.00 EPS in Q4 2026 (the 'four-by-four' $4 run-rate challenge). Q2 was $0.96 and Q3 consensus is $0.95-0.96. Whether the call reaffirms that goal or pushes it out is the forward line this print can move. With 15% loan growth and repricing loans, reaffirmation is the more likely outcome, but it is already public.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The target was set on the Q1 2026 call (stock +0.9%) and progress was shown on the Q2 call (+1.95%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a public target sitting inside the guide. The only unpriced part is the direction of the update, which I cannot source. Hence near zero.
findings.independence: The Investing.com summary of the Q2 call repeats a target of about $4 annualized EPS by Q4 2026 (cited via the 247wallst/Investing.com summaries, https://247wallst.com/cards/smartfinancial-q2-2026-earnings-smbk-01ky0nghwm2080y5cypfessec3). Same company source.

findings.finding: Short interest nearly doubled into the print: 328,297 shares (2026-07-15) became 636,039 (2026-09-30). That is about 3.7% of 17.1M shares outstanding, with days to cover of 3.94. Somebody is building a short or hedge position into a name trading near its 52-week high.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print with a comparable short build on record. 2025 short interest ran 0.5-0.7% of float.
findings.why_not_priced: The FINRA data is public but nobody aggregates it for a 109k-share-a-day bank. At 3.7% it is not crowded enough to make a squeeze mechanism. On a beat, covering 4 days of volume could add to an up-move, which is why the band is wide on both sides.
findings.independence: Benzinga flagged SI at 2.3% of float and 'rising' on 2026-08-27 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SMBK/short-interest). Same FINRA series.

findings.finding: The EVP and Chief Credit Officer made small open-market sales: 430 shares at $52.75 on 2026-08-04 and 230 shares at $52.05 on 2026-09-14, leaving 11,142 shares. These are the only insider filings since the Q2 print.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial size (about 5% of his holding). A credit officer selling at all is the only signal, and a weak one. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: The 2026-08-04 Form 4 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1038773/000165273926000010/form4-08042026_050802.xml) is the same person, so this is one finding.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with. The mild positive lean matches the name's up-bias in history (6 of 7) and cuts slightly against a building short (doubled since July), so p_up is held at 55 rather than higher.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (inside the guide): the beat finding moved from +0.6 to +0.5, because the bar equals the company's own guide arithmetic. The bar itself is two-source plus guide, so it is not capped.
Rule 6/5: the peer deposit-cost finding moved from -0.5 to -0.4. It is a proxy and partly inside the guide, since SMBK already guided NIM down for deposit pressure.
Rule 6: the $1.00 Q4 target finding moved from +0.2 to +0.1. It is a public target inside the guide.
Insider-sale finding moved from -0.1 to -0.05 as immaterial.
Rule 7: short interest was checked before the negatives. At 3.7% it is not crowded, so the -0.2 is unchanged.
Rule 8: abs_move_pct is held at 3.5, above the 2.98 median, and not shrunk.
